title: Process._getActiveRequests and process._getActiveHandles are deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates process._getActiveRequests and process._getActiveHandles (DEP0161: documentation-only since v17.6.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of process._getActiveRequests and process._getActiveHandles with process.getActiveResourcesInfo().

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
